Synopsis:
Chevron is finalising the migration of all its Venezuelan oil joint ventures into Venezuela's new energy framework. The deal, expected to be announced imminently, grants Chevron greater operational control and enables expansion of its Petropiar heavy crude project into the Ayacucho 8 block, plus a second Orinoco Belt project expansion. A potential new acreage addition is also under discussion. Other foreign companies are expected to sign similar contract migrations simultaneously.
